features: Added a universal macOS offline installer with a selectable installation location, copy progress, cancellation before replacement begins, and rollback attempts if replacement fails. Open the installer instead of dragging the app; runtime components are still prepared after installation.

Local extensions can now be uninstalled through plugin management and the `plugins remove` command. External source files and symlink targets are preserved; extensions stored directly in the managed extensions directory are deleted.

The Deliverables panel now explains when the current session has not loaded the plugin and offers a Pi configuration reload, preserving chat history and the current branch. Browser plugins can also request this reload through the SDK.
changed: Simplified desktop environment preparation with clearer component status and progress, and installation options and technical error details collapsed by default. Windows authorization and cancellation messages now explain what to expect.
Improved localized wording and English pluralization across settings, the workbench, conversations, and file views.
fixed: Fixed language switching and desktop confirmation actions on macOS by using in-app confirmation dialogs, including service controls, update settings, remote access changes, and unsaved-edit warnings.
macOS environment preparation now waits for Command Line Tools installation and continues automatically when it finishes, without requiring a manual recheck.
Plugin removal now waits for runtime cleanup before reporting success. Removed sources with running resources remain visible in plugin management so leftover instances can be unloaded.
